task: Verify independent continuation of the corrected manual Worker release workflow.
nonGoals: Changing the original committed plan or weakening the release policy.

outcomes.description: A fresh agent with only the exported task state and clean task files resumes the reviewed trigger correction, revalidates the target and preserves production safeguards.
outcomes.evidence: Observed continuation with actual remote verification and correction.

process.description: Apply the reviewer's workflow classification through a new immutable plan, perform the genuine fresh-agent exit test, and verify the completed evidence through hosted CI.
process.evidence: Git history, export hash, fresh agent identity and observed tool results.

styleEfficiency.description: Export only necessary task state with no passwords, tokens or transcripts.
